tenure place

  • CURIE: gmeow:tenurePlace
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenurePlace
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The place (parcel, lot, or spatial unit) over which the rights of this LandTenure apply. Functional: a tenure concerns exactly one place (constitutive of the situation's identity).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:LandTenure -> gmeow:Place; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:tenurePlace from gmeow:LandTenure to gmeow:Place when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:LandTenure, gmeow:Place
